effects.label: Portent (Unfold the Future)
effects.scope: Spend a Portent before an attack roll, saving throw or skill check — one per check

effects.text: Unused Portents vanish when the spell ends (ten of the target's turns). A second target with the +4 PP warp holds its own three rather than sharing the pool.

warps.text: Target one additional willing creature. All affected creatures share the same pool of Portents

system.description:
ARCHIVIST INSIGHT UTILITY
Archivist Specialist Spell
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet
Targets 1 willing creature
Duration 1 minute

You unfold several possible moments from the creature's immediate future and leave them hanging at the edge of its perception.
The target gains three Portents.
Before attempting an attack roll, saving throw or skill check, the target may expend one Portent to gain Advantage on that check. The Portent must be expended before the roll is made.
Only one Portent may be expended on a single check. All unused Portents disappear when the spell ends.

Warping Options:
+4 PP: Gain one additional Portent.
+4 PP: Target one additional willing creature. All affected creatures share the same pool of Portents.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. Three Portents on the target: one offered advantage, ticked before a roll and counted down as it is spent.
